text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! The only Umamusume to<n>stand in the way
of Oguri Cap the<n>Hero!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Super Creek! The winner of the<n>autumn Tenno
Sho is Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, this is what happens when<n>my trainer
and I get serious!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You ran well, Oguri! I may have even<n>been a teensy
bit nervous. ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, you're a tough opponent... I<n>didn't think
you'd stick it out on the<n>final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But this still isn't stettled. I want both<n>you and
Tamtam to take me on next<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Our final battle will be the Arima Kinen.<n>To all our
fans out there, please come<n>and watch the climax,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we did it! Did I pull off the<n>villain act?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then how about I praise you in<n>a villainous
way as your reward?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Come, bow your head in submission.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Heheh! Such a fine subordinate. Yes<n>you are!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her villainous act, Super<n>Creek's touch is
as gentle as<n>always.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Only the senior Arima Kinen remains.<n>Winning that
will make me the<n>queen...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And you, the queen's prized trainer,<n>will be the best
in the world! ♪ Let's<n>make our dream come
true—together.
